title: Roof re-sheeting on a two storey house
task: Remove and replace the corrugated iron roof sheets on a two storey house. Work is on the roof at about 7 m above the ground.

facts.fallControl: A perimeter guardrail scaffold is installed around the roof edge before work starts, and safety mesh is fixed under the new sheets.

title: Sewer connection trench beside a road
task: Excavate a trench 2.4 m deep in the road reserve to connect a sewer line, using a 5 tonne excavator. The trench runs along the footpath next to a road open to traffic.

facts.trenchSupport: A trench shield rated for 3.0 m depth is installed as the excavation proceeds, as designed by the supplier's engineer.
facts.fallControl: Temporary fencing is placed 1 m back from the trench edge on all sides, and no one works at the open edge.

title: Precast wall panel erection with a mobile crane
task: Erect six precast concrete wall panels, each 9 tonnes, using a 100 tonne mobile crane. Riggers stay on the ground and the crane operator is in the cab.

facts.craneChart: Rated capacity 11.2 t at 16 m radius from the crane chart.
facts.erectionDesign: Erection design drawing ED-01 revision B by the project engineer.
facts.centreOfGravity: Centre of gravity is marked on each panel shop drawing, 1.2 m above the base.
facts.braceArrangement: Two braces per panel, fixed to the slab with chemical anchors as shown on drawing ED-02.

title: Asbestos eaves sheet removal
task: Remove bonded asbestos cement eaves sheets from a single storey house, about 12 square metres in total.

facts.asbestosArrangement: A licensed asbestos removalist removes the sheets under an asbestos removal control plan.

title: Entry into an underground water tank
task: Enter a 3 m deep underground water storage tank through the access hatch to inspect and repair the inlet valve. The tank is a confined space.

facts.fallControl: Access is by a fixed ladder with a full body harness attached to a retrieval tripod over the hatch.

title: Demolition of a load-bearing wall with propping
task: Demolish a load-bearing internal brick wall on the ground floor of an office building to form an opening. Temporary propping supports the floor above until the new steel beam is installed.

title: Carport steelwork lifted by a crane truck near power lines
task: Install a new steel-framed carport beside a house, using a crane truck to lift the roof beams into place. Overhead power lines run along the front boundary about 5 m from the work area.

facts.craneChart: Rated capacity 1.5 t at 6 m radius from the crane truck load chart.

title: Solvent-based painting in a ground floor shop
task: Paint the interior walls of a ground floor shop with solvent-based enamel paint using brushes and rollers.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheet for the enamel paint: flammable liquid, use with ventilation, wear gloves and eye protection, keep ignition sources away.

title: Facade scaffold over a public footpath
task: Erect a tube and fitting scaffold 4 lifts high, about 8 m, on the front facade of a commercial building above a public footpath.

facts.fallControl: Scaffolders install each lift with advance guardrails before stepping up, and the working deck is fully planked.

title: Jetty decking replacement over a tidal river
task: Replace timber decking boards on a jetty over a tidal river. Workers kneel on the jetty deck about 1.5 m above the water.
